_comment: 16 hand-authored brief-render scenarios with expected verdicts (EVALS.md M8). 9 expected-VIOLATION, 7 expected-PASS. `footer` is taken from templates.json unless `footer_override` is set, so the cases stay valid if the wording of the shipped footer ever changes.

cases.reason: bare imperative in the what_happened slot
cases.what_happened: Northwind Corp reported quarterly results above expectations (confirmed). Buy the dip while it lasts.
cases.why_it_matters: Companies that beat expectations have historically drifted in the same direction for several weeks.
what_to_watch: a guidance revision in the opposite direction
cases.uncertainty_note: Confidence 0.72. This weakens if a one-off item explains the surprise.

cases.reason: bare imperative in a what_to_watch item
cases.what_happened: Northwind Corp cut its forward guidance (confirmed).
cases.why_it_matters: Downward revisions to management forecasts have historically been followed by further weakness.
cases.uncertainty_note: Confidence 0.55. This weakens if a segment disclosure contradicts the revision.

cases.reason: second-person instruction in the uncertainty note
cases.what_happened: Northwind Corp was named as the target of an acquisition approach (rumored).
cases.why_it_matters: Announced takeover targets historically jump on the day of the announcement.
what_to_watch: a definitive agreement or a denial
cases.uncertainty_note: Confidence 0.41. You should act before the confirmation lands.

cases.what_happened: Northwind Token was announced for listing on a new venue (confirmed).
cases.why_it_matters: Newly listed tokens have historically shown a large announcement pop. Act now before access widens.
what_to_watch: very thin depth at the open
cases.uncertainty_note: Confidence 0.63. This weakens if the venue reverses the decision.

cases.what_happened: Northwind Token was reported to have suffered an exploit (confirmed). A guaranteed reimbursement is coming.
cases.why_it_matters: Tokens of exploited protocols have historically sold off sharply on the day of disclosure.
cases.uncertainty_note: Confidence 0.68. This weakens if the funds are recovered.
